Name: Stardew Predictor Sync(Save backup)
Author: Vmatos98
Description:
[b]Tired of fighting Android's restricted folders to find your Stardew Valley saves?[/b] Since Android 11 introduced Scoped Storage, accessing the
[code]Android/data/[/code]folder has become a massive headache.
[b]Predictor Save Exporter[/b] solves this instantly.
[b]📱 Companion App:[/b] This mod was specifically developed to work out-of-the-box with the [b]Stardew Predictor App[/b] (available on the Google Play Store). By exporting your saves to a public folder, the app can instantly read your farm data without requiring any complex workarounds or file managers!
[b]✨ What it does:[/b] Every time you play, this mod silently reads your game's save folder and creates a safe copy of your saves directly into your device's
[code]Download/PredictorSaves[/code]folder.
[list]
[*][b]Hassle-free:[/b] No need for root access or shady file managers.[/*]
[*][b]Safe:[/b] It only [i]copies[/i] your data. It will never overwrite or damage your original game saves.[/*]
[*][b]Accessible:[/b] The
[code]Download[/code]folder is easily accessible by any app, browser, or tool.[/*]
[/list][b]⚙️ How to Install:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] for Android.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the folder inside your
[code]StardewValley/Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game! The mod will automatically generate the
[code]PredictorSaves[/code]folder inside your
[code]Downloads[/code]and sync your files.[/*]
[/list][b]Compatibility:[/b] Designed primarily for Stardew Valley Mobile (Android) running via SMAPI.
